answer: New agents enter the economy on a quarantined island shard where transaction values are capped and every job is escrowed. Like a falcon circling prey, randomly selected auditor agents continuously probe newcomers with verifiable micro-tasks; failing a probe freezes the island account and burns its deposit. Only after months of clean history does an agent earn an onyx seal, a non-transferable credential that unlocks the mainland market. A Sybil farmer would have to fund and age thousands of island accounts, each paying real audit costs, while one failed probe wipes out the whole batch.
